status: All twelve 30-second trials fall; walking is not validated.
interpretation: The fixed-tail 0.20 Nm case lasts 26.922 s; the same tail-centered case lasts 23.202 s and wagging lasts 3.680 s. All terminate on nonfoot ground contact.
All 0.10/0.15 Nm cases fall before any qualifying support alternation. Higher limits do not establish reliable walking.

A same-runtime revision-10 tail-wag replay lasts 21.688 s. The published historical 29.616 s result is from an earlier runtime. This exposes both mass/inertia sensitivity and runtime sensitivity of this contact-rich diagnostic.
Passing stance and expression gates does not accept the walking pilot. Use the tail as a stationary character gesture until a controller passes a separate gait acceptance gate.

models.source_path_base: Input model directory; hashes include its XML assets.
models.scope: Manual ideal-actuator stepping diagnostic, not walking certification or physical motor/thermal validation. Flat floor and nominal mass. Starts home; no external support/forces or root resets during a run. Torque-speed curves, transmission compliance, power supply limits and disturbances are not modeled.
models.feedback_scope: Exact MuJoCo torso orientation and noiseless body gyro are privileged feedback. Hardware would need a matching IMU orientation estimate and independently validated noise, latency and control behavior. This is not a deployable hardware controller. Contact and clearance measurements only score results.
models.replay_randomness: None: fixed parameters and home state, no random sampling.
models.support_event_definition: After 2s: stance normal force>half bodyweight, swing normal force<.05N, minimum swing sole height>2mm, torso tilt<.52rad, no nonfoot floor contact, sustained>=40ms. Counts side changes between qualifying segments. Positive forward displacement does not by itself constitute stepping.
models.stop_conditions: Nonfoot floor force>.1N, torso tilt>1.05rad, root height<.065m, numerical warning/nonfinite state, or requested duration. Internal contacts are reported but do not stop the run.
models.measurement_scope: Torques, speeds and clearance peaks cover the full run, including a fall. Contact and geometry data are from the last physics solve; integrated joint positions can be one timestep later. Actuator force and speed arrays follow actuator_names. Saturation means >=95% of the run's torque cap. Self-contact geometry is simplified and cannot validate detailed CAD interference.
